_comment: Resources AMDG shares with the wider research community. 'instrument' is the featured hardware block at the top of the section: 'sponsor' matches the agency-badge style used on project cards, and 'photo' is an optional /images/... path — the block renders text-only until an image exists at src/assets/images/resources/ matching that path. 'tools' are web apps rendered as cards below it: 'name' and 'description' are required; 'url' renders a link line (omit it and the card shows no link, e.g. while a tool is in beta); 'status' renders a small pill (colors live in STATUS_COLORS in ResourceCard.astro).

tools.name: digitalimagecorrelation.org
tools.description: A practical guide to digital image correlation, written for newcomers. It covers speckle patterning, image capture, calibration, and error validation, and surveys the available open-source DIC software.

tools.name: e2283.app
tools.description: Extreme value analysis of inclusion lengths following ASTM E2283. Enter 24 measurements and the app returns a Gumbel fit, for use by the fatigue community.

tools.name: PreCureSim
tools.description: Simulation of curing and yield for preceramic polymers.

instrument.name: Psylotech µTS
instrument.description: A compact tensile testing system that can operate inside of a scanning electron microscope, as well as outside with optical microscopes and a 1600°C air furnace. It can pull up to 1.6 kN and can run fatigue tests at tens of Hz and hundreds of N.
instrument.photoAlt: The Psylotech µTS compact mechanical testing system.
instrument.sponsorNote: Funding: NSF Major Research Instrumentation award no. 2320690.
instrument.access: The µTS is open for use by anyone in the U.S. research community. To discuss access, contact Prof. William LePage.
